use_case_summary: Customer building RAG-powered document discovery for litigation & compliance: embeddings for semantic search across 100M+ docs, lightweight reranking to improve precision for lawyer workflows, must support audit trails and strict retention policies.
requirements_summary: Indexing scale: target production index ~120M documents; initial POC 12M doc subset.
Embeddings: 512-1536 dim vectors acceptable; prefer quantized vector store to reduce storage & cost.
Reranking: on-top transformer reranker for top-K (K=100) candidates; want ability to run reranker in private VPC with model pinned.
Latency: interactive search latency target 95th <= 250ms for small queries (lawyer Q/A); acceptable higher for long-form summarization.
Throughput: bursty weekday peaks ~1k qps across org, average sustained ~120 qps during review windows.
Cost sensitivity: target cost per query (end-to-end) < $0.02 for basic semantic recall queries; reranker budgeted separately.
Security: full audit logging of query text, redaction pipeline for PII, SSO/SAML + SCIM, KMS integration for keys.
Data residency & retention: EU residence for some customers, retention controls with legal-hold overrides necessary.
Deployment: prefer private control plane with option to run inference in-customer VPC or on-prem for air-gapped customers.
notes: POC scoped as: 12M doc ingest -> embeddings -> vector store (quantized) -> ANN search -> reranker -> UI integration (lawyer review).
